sources.title: GitHub - mll-lab-nu/MindCube
sources.snippet: MindCube is a modular framework for generating and evaluating spatial reasoning datasets for multimodal AI models. The project follows a complete pipeline from raw data to model evaluation, with specialized modules for scaffold data curation, prompt generation, model inference, training, and comprehensive evaluation.

sources.title: MindCube: Spatial Mental Modeling from Limited Views
sources.snippet: MindCube: a spatial reasoning benchmark of 21,154 questions on 3,268 multi-view images, testing whether vision-language models build spatial mental models of unseen space and reason from limited views. VLMs are near-random; map-then-reason training lifts accuracy from 37.8% to 57.8%, and to 61.3% with reinforcement learning.

sources.title: MindCube: Spatial Mental Modeling from Limited Views
sources.snippet: Can Vision-Language Models (VLMs) imagine the full scene from just a few views, like humans do? Humans form spatial mental models naturally, internal representations of unseen space, to reason about layout, perspective, and motion.
